previous_references.reference_prompt: Extract and reconstruct ONE complete ancient Chinese mountain bridge from the source image. Continuous dark weathered timber balustrades and stone posts on both sides, pale snow on the deck, caps and rails. Clearly show the complete load-bearing structure BELOW the deck: several tall blue-grey masonry piers connected by sturdy stone arches, with visible arch openings. Piers descend well below the deck. One coherent connected bridge, open walkable entrance and exit. Show the entire asset, both endpoints and all supports in an elevated three-quarter side view with enough top view to read the bend, generous padding, realistic PBR materials, neutral diffuse light and plain light grey background. No mountains, ground, buildings, people, dragon, trees, water, text, watermark or collage.
